source.citation: Palandri, J. L., Kharaka, Y. K. (2004). A compilation of rate parameters of water-mineral interaction kinetics for application to geochemical modeling. U.S. Geological Survey Open-File Report 2004-1068.

transcription.from: the published report (PDF from pubs.usgs.gov), Table 33, p. 42
transcription.note: The calcite acid and neutral parameters were typed in docstring examples of src/kinetics/rate_models.jl and in docs/src/manual/kinetics_syntax.md, as 10^log k rounded to four digits; they agree with the table.

notes: log k is the decimal logarithm of the rate constant in mol m^-2 s^-1 at 25 C (for the acid mechanism, at pH 0); E is the Arrhenius activation energy; n is the reaction order with respect to H+ (acid) or to P(CO2) (carbonate).
Dawsonite, for which the table gives only a neutral mechanism, is left out. The activation energies of magnesite are those of calcite, which the report assigns to it for want of data.
